title: Machine Learning in Fish Farming
abstract: arXiv:2609.13919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This chapter explores how machine learning (ML) is transforming aquaculture, with a particular focus on enhancing decision-making processes and improving operational efficiency. The chapter is structured to first introduce the challenges in aquaculture and the role of AI and then provide an overview of ML techniques in the context of aquaculture, followed by applications, emerging trends, future directions, and case studies. The focus is on real-world applications of ML techniques, including Random Forest, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), as well as emerging technologies such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and large language models (LLMs). Key applications include biomass estimation, species recognition, behavioural analysis, and environmental forecasting. The chapter also highlights the synergy between ML and the Internet of Things (IoT) for real-time monitoring and decision support. Ultimatel

translated_title: 机器学习在水产养殖中的应用
translated_abstract: 本章探讨了机器学习（ML）如何变革水产养殖业，特别关注增强决策过程和提高运营效率。本章首先介绍水产养殖面临的挑战以及人工智能的作用，然后概述机器学习技术在水产养殖中的应用背景，随后介绍其应用实例、新兴趋势、未来方向和案例研究。重点在于机器学习技术的实际应用，包括随机森林、卷积神经网络（CNN）和循环神经网络（RNN），以及图神经网络（GNN）和大语言模型（LLM）等新兴技术。关键应用包括生物量估算、物种识别、行为分析和环境预测。本章还强调了机器学习与物联网（IoT）在实时监控和决策支持方面的协同作用。
tldr: 本章系统综述了随机森林、CNN、RNN以及GNN和大语言模型等机器学习技术在水产养殖中的实际应用，涵盖生物量估算、物种识别、行为分析和环境预测等关键任务，并强调了机器学习与物联网协同实现实时监控和决策支持的作用。
en_tdlr: This chapter provides a comprehensive overview of machine learning techniques—from Random Forest and CNNs to emerging GNNs and LLMs—in aquaculture applications such as biomass estimation, species recognition, behavioral analysis, and environmental forecasting, highlighting the synergy between ML and IoT for real-time monitoring and decision support.
